query:
UPDATE series SET
                name = $2,
                sort_key = $3,
                identifiers = identifiers || $4,
                images = images || $5,
                description = COALESCE($6, description),
                total_book_count = COALESCE($7, total_book_count),
                is_monitored = COALESCE($8, is_monitored),
                auto_want_mode = CASE
                    WHEN $9::text IS NOT NULL AND $9::text != 'none' THEN $9::text
                    ELSE auto_want_mode
                END,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
